description: Frederick County TransIT Routes is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. This layer displays TransIT shuttles, connectors, and Meet-The-MARC routes. All routes contain variations when applicable. Routes have been symbolized. Shapefiles were created by Frederick County and attribute table was cleaned up by Central Maryland Regional Transit. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are md imap, allegany, bus, carroll, cecil. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
